title: Mutual Action Plan & readiness checklist — SolaceTherm start-date gating
text:
Mutual Action Plan & readiness checklist — SolaceTherm start-date gating

['From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy@solacetherm.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual Action Plan draft & gating for start-date

Amy — attaching the MAP snapshot we walked through on Friday and a condensed readiness checklist so we can lock a start week. Key asks so we can hit the proposed 2027-01-10 start: 

- Procurement: confirm SOW + PO (we can accept e-sign or scanned PO) by 2026-12-20
- Security: final SOC2 evidence and IP/data flow note accepted by 2026-12-22
- Legal: final redlines on the commercial appendix by 2026-12-23
- Ops: orientation call (30 min) during week of 2026-12-27 for on-prem connector + network test

I attached SOW_v3 with the updated throughput SLA and a short security Q&A we agreed to. If procurement needs a mutual action checklist formatted as a PO attachment, tell me and I’ll generate it.

Possible start-date windows: 2027-01-10 (preferred), 2027-01-17 (fallback).

Next step: can you confirm procurement deadline and whether signer is Amy or your legal team?

Thanks —
Dylan
Dylan Brooks | Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0142

Attachment: SolaceTherm_SOW_v3.pdf (38KB)
Attachment: SolaceTherm_Security_Responses.xlsx (62KB)', 'From: Amy Chen <amy@solacetherm.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@solacetherm.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan draft & gating for start-date

Dylan — thanks for the summary and the docs. Procurement reviewed the SOW and has three practical asks before we can issue a PO: 

1) Payment terms: Net-45 instead of Net-30. Is that acceptable?
2) Data residency note: we require a written acknowledgment that training data is not retained by Redwood — can Legal give a one-paragraph attest?
3) Signature authority: finance can sign commercial terms up to $250k; anything above needs CFO signoff (we expect this to be $210k so finance will sign).

We can meet the 2026-12-20 internal deadline for a PO issuance provided Legal returns the short residency statement by 2026-12-18. 

For network/ops: can we schedule the orientation call the week of 2026-12-27? Procurement prefers 30th Dec in the morning PST.

I’ve attached the procurement intake form with our routing.

—Amy
Amy Chen | Head of Product Operations | SolaceTherm Inc
Procurement: procurement@solacetherm.com

Attachment: procurement-intake-solacetherm.pdf (12KB)', 'From: laura.bennett@redwood.com <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: approvals checklist + who signs on Redwood side

Team — quick internal note as we prep responses for SolaceTherm: 

- Legal (Kim): can you draft the one-paragraph data residency attestation and share redline comments on the commercial appendix? We should avoid reopening SLAs if possible.
- Finance (Vivek): confirm our acceptance of Net-45 for this deal and whether the commercial team needs to push price to offset term change.
- Sales Ops (me): I’ll prepare the PO-ready SOW bundle (SOW_v3 + security sheet + one-paragraph attestation) and a DocuSign envelope so Amy’s finance can sign quickly.

Target internal approval timeline: Legal and Finance sign-off by 2026-12-16 so we can return materials to SolaceTherm on the 17th and still get their PO by 12-20. If Legal needs more time, call out which clause is blocking.

Thanks —
Laura
Laura Bennett | GTM Operations | Redwood Inference', 'From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy@solacetherm.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, procurement@solacetherm.com
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 16:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan draft & gating for start-date — confirmation and sign schedule

Amy / team — quick update and final schedule: 

1) Legal attestation: Kimberly (cc'd) has added a short residency statement and attached redlines to the commercial appendix. Excerpt: "Redwood Inference does not retain customer training inputs for model training; persistent storage is customer-controlled per the SOW." Full text attached.

2) Finance: Vivek confirms acceptance of Net-45 for this contract; no price adjustment required.

3) DocuSign bundle: Laura will send a single envelope that includes SOW_v3, the one-paragraph residency attestation, and the commercial appendix redline acceptance. Expect the envelope at 2026-12-17 09:00 PST.

4) Orientation call: scheduled for Wed 2026-12-30 09:30 PST (30 min). Calendar invite will follow.

5) Proposed sign & start cadence: 
   - 2026-12-17: Redwood sends DocuSign bundle to Amy/Procurement
   - 2026-12-20: SolaceTherm issues PO or returns signed DocuSign (target)
   - 2027-01-10: Preferred production start (soft-launch limited throughput, canary enabled)
   - 2027-01-17: Fallback start if signatures/PO slip

If Procurement needs an alternative (e.g., scanned PO + email), we can accept that as long as it reaches us by 12-20. I’ll also attach a brief start-week runbook so operations can plan the canary ramp.

Thanks for the fast coordination — excited to get SolaceTherm onto Redwood.

Dylan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0142

Attachments: redlines-solacetherm.docx (9KB), start-week-runbook.txt (3KB)']
